DESIGN DEMONSTRATIONSample data · No banking connection

A short client walkthrough

  1. Start at the login page. Use the prefilled sample details and verification code 000000.
  2. Show the dashboard, then Accounts for balances, account details and searchable activity.
  3. Open Transfers. Choose a transfer type, enter an amount, review and verify with 000000. For a new recipient, complete recipient details first, then payment details.
  4. Open Transfer history or Scheduled transfers and select a record to see the detail-panel loader. Select another record quickly to check that only the latest selection appears.
  5. Open Beneficiaries and Add beneficiary to explore type tiles. Select View contact details below the relationship manager to open the sample contact panel.
  6. Change Preview role to Approver. Open the approval queue, select a request and approve or reject using 000000.

All names, balances and transactions are illustrative. Actions affect this preview only. Reloading or restarting resets the demonstration. This is a design prototype, not a deployed Temenos application.
